query:
SELECT 
  m.sponsor_id,
  m.time_slot,
  m.attendee_number,
  COUNT(*) as meeting_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.attendee_id ORDER BY m.id) as attendee_ids
FROM meetings m
WHERE m.time_slot IS NOT NULL
  AND m.status IN ('suggested', 'confirmed')
GROUP BY m.sponsor_id, m.time_slot, m.attendee_number
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY m.sponsor_id, m.time_slot;
